Prologue: The Wood Age

#StepGoal
1A Page in the WindOpen your first Prize Crate and read the book inside.
2Ada's CampSleep through a night in a bed. A leaf bed, like Ada's, is best.
3The First PartnerChoose your starter Pokémon.
4Stepping StonesBring the whole group into the Stone Age.

#StepGoal

#StepGoal

11Three BadgesReach the Diamond Age (3 different badges).

#StepGoal
